subject: still no music line up :(
author: PsychedelicBabe
body:
....The only way to have a true friend...Is to be one....

On the main event days, Friday 31st October and Saturday 1st November, thousands are expected to descend on Trafalgar Square during the BE THE ONE event to play the latest games.  On show at BE THE ONE will be many of Europe’s best selling franchises and consumer favourites like FIFA, Need For Speed™, The Sims™, Harry Potter, and a wide range of casual and family titles for Nintendo platforms including LITTLEST PET SHOP, Boogie™ SuperStar, Zubo and MONOPOLY.  Hot new gaming brands will also be included in the show like Sims 3, SimAnimals, Mirror’s Edge, Battleforge, Spore, the brand new top-selling Warhammer Online: Age of Reckoning as well as forthcoming mega-hit Rock Band 2 from MTV Games/Harmonix.  With a variety of special guests, entertaining challenges and performances planned there will be plenty for everyone to see and do at BE THE ONE 2008. Still no music line up though :p

subject: London Games Festival 2008!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Thanks for the Heads Up!

Although I'm not sure I will bother with the trek to London, it is nice knowing about these things before they happen. Last year when Burnout Paradise was featured we didn't hear about it until after the event.

The video on the official webpage shows a snippet of Mirror's Edge, so if our Mirror's Edge interview hasn't convinced you to buy this game, it might be worth heading down to Trafalger Square to take a look.

EA Be The One London '08

It doesn't look like the bands have been announced yet, but should be a good day out for all gamers! 🙂

This event is just part of the London Games Festival which has loads of gaming events across the capital.
